## Description

Bicep stamp template for a dedicated hospital deployment (Container Apps or AKS when isolation/node pools require it), customer-managed keys in Managed HSM, private link/VPN to the HIS, own upgrade ring and maintenance window, registration in the control plane.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A new stamp can be created from the template without manual steps and registered for routing.
- [ ] **AC2.** Hospital data, keys, logs and backups are isolated from pooled tenants.
- [ ] **AC3.** Decision to move from App Service to AKS is recorded with the triggering evidence.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
